## Change

Describe the problem, resulting behavior, and relevant development stage.
Link the issue if applicable.

## Validation

Record the tested commit/source state, OS, compiler/version, configuration,
commands, and results. For Windows host runs, include a redacted result summary
and relevant logs. Report MSVC, clang-cl, and Linux evidence separately and
identify environments not tested. Explain any remaining gaps.

## Checklist

- [ ] The description distinguishes implemented behavior from planned capabilities; host checks do not establish unlock, boot, driver, CUDA, or Strata support.
- [ ] Relevant checks passed, or failures and omitted checks are explained above.
- [ ] Behavior changes include appropriate synthetic regression coverage and updated documentation.
- [ ] Contributions are GPL-2.0-only compatible; upstream notices, attribution, and source provenance are preserved.
- [ ] No firmware dumps, proprietary binaries, secrets, recovery keys, or unredacted personal/hardware identifiers are included.
